description_en: Calls the UpdateProject operation to update the CU or service role information of a project
description_zh: 调用UpdateProject接口更新项目的CU或服务角色信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm update-project --project immtest --new-cu 6 --new-service-role immroletest --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProject

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is not required for content management projects created after April 1, 2021. Projects created before this date are not affected.

This parameter can be modified only when the billing type of the project is ByCU.

The maximum number of requests that can be processed per second. Valid values: 0 to 10. A value of 1 indicates that only one request can be processed per second. A value of 0 indicates that the project is no longer billed
parameters.help_zh:
2021.04.01以后创建的类型为内容管理的项目不需要传该参数，在此之前已创建的项目不受影响。

当项目的计费类型为ByCU时，此参数才能修改。

每秒能够处理的最大请求数。取值范围为0~10。该值为1表示每秒钟只能处理1个请求，该值为0表示项目不再计费
parameters.name: new_cu

parameters.help_en:
The service role that grants Intelligent Media Management (IMM) permissions to access other cloud resources such as OSS.

You can also create an authorization role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console. For more information, see Create a regular service role (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116800.html)
parameters.help_zh:
服务角色，授权给IMM服务以访问其他云资源（例如OSS）的权限。

您也可以通过RAM控制台创建授权角色。具体操作，请参见创建普通服务角色 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116800.html)
parameters.name: new_service_role
